name: verification-environment-health-monitor
description: Monitors the health, duration, and cost of the agent-managed verification environments that power AWS DevOps Agent release readiness reviews: build and test success rates, provisioning failures, run durations, and attributable spend. Read-only. Recommends AWS MCP augmentation (AWS Billing and Cost Management MCP Server and AWS Pricing MCP Server) used alongside the connected associations and AWS reads.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on THU at 06:00 UTC
